about: 관리 > 근무입력(E090113) · 근무조회(E090105) — 원본처럼 근무일자가 비면 '근무일자를 확인바랍니다.' 로 막히고, 저장하면 폼이 비워지며 근무조회에 '일자 -번호' 전표로 뜬다. [근무기록확정]으로 그 달 확정하면 급여명세에 확정값 × 단가가 변동수당으로 들어간다. 시험용 수당항목 · 전표 · 명세는 지운다.

shots.name: 근무조회에 전표 → 급여명세에 변동수당 25,000 → 뒷정리
steps: js:(async()=>{const t=localStorage.getItem('erp_token');const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+t,'Content-Type':'application/json'};const y=new Date().getFullYear();const slips=await (await fetch('/api/work-records?from='+y+'-01-01&to='+y+'-12-31',{headers:h})).json();const s=slips.find(x=>x.payItemLabel==='QA관리-시간수당');const emps=await (await fetch('/api/employees',{headers:h})).json();const e=emps.find(x=>x.code==='EMP-0003');const ld=await (await fetch('/api/work-records/confirms/2091-02/load',{headers:h})).json();await fetch('/api/work-records/confirms/2091-02',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(ld.map(r=>({employeeId:r.employeeId,payItemId:r.payItemId,quantity:r.quantity})))});const pr=await fetch('/api/payslips',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({employeeId:e.id,payMonth:'2091-02'})});const p=await pr.json();const line=(p.lines||[]).find(l=>l.name==='QA관리-시간수당');if(p.id)await fetch('/api/payslips/'+p.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});await fetch('/api/work-records/confirms/2091-02',{method:'DELETE',headers:h});await fetch('/api/work-records/'+s.slipDate+'/'+s.slipNo,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});const items=await (await fetch('/api/pay-settings/items',{headers:h})).json();const it=items.find(x=>x.code==='QAWR');await fetch('/api/pay-settings/items/'+it.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});sessionStorage.setItem('qaWr',String(pr.ok&&!!line&&Number(line.amount)===25000));return true})()
